definition: Justin Zobel is an Australian computer scientist working in information retrieval, search engine technology, and research evaluation.
details: He is a Redmond Barry Distinguished Professor in the School of Computing and Information Systems at the University of Melbourne and serves as Pro Vice-Chancellor for Graduate & International Research.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Justin Zobel.
